$comment: What the sheets show about RV32GC that the Sail model and LLVM TableGen do not carry: sections, groups and their titles, the order of rows, descriptions and pseudocode, HINT and reserved rows, unused opcodes, pseudo-instructions. tools/isa/gen-rv32gc.mjs merges it with them into src/isa/generated/rv32gc.mjs.

c.lui.title: Load Upper Immediate / Add to SP

c.cr.title: CR Control Transfer / Register Operations
c.cr.pseudocode: ( ra = PC + 2 ; ) PC = rs1  |  rd = rd (funct4) rs2

amo.title: Atomic Operations
amo.pseudocode: t = M[rs1] ; M[rs1] = t (funct5) rs2 ; rd = t

csr.title: Control and Status Registers
csr.pseudocode: rd = CSR ; CSR = f( CSR, rs1 | zimm )

instructions.description: RESERVED (nzuimm = 0) — 0x0000 is the defined illegal instruction

instructions.description: Add Immediate (×4) to SP into rd'

HINT — c.lui with rd = x0 (standard use)
CUSTOM — c.srli / c.srai with shamt[5] = 1: designated for custom extensions (RV32)
RESERVED on RV32 (c.subw / c.addw on RV64)

instructions.name: c.bnez
instructions.description: Branch if Not Equal to Zero
HINT — c.slli with rd = x0 (custom use)
CUSTOM — c.slli with shamt[5] = 1: designated for custom extensions (RV32)
HINT — c.mv with rd = x0 (standard use)
HINT — c.add with rd = x0 (standard use; rs2 = x2–x5 are c.ntl.p1 / pall / s1 / all)

instructions.name: ebreak
instructions.pseudocode: transfer control back to debug environment

instructions.name: sc.w
instructions.pseudocode: if reserved { M[rs1] = rs2 ; rd = 0 } else rd ≠ 0

instructions.name: amoswap.w
instructions.pseudocode: t = M[rs1] ; M[rs1] = rs2 ; rd = t

instructions.name: amoadd.w
instructions.pseudocode: t = M[rs1] ; M[rs1] = t + rs2 ; rd = t

instructions.name: amoxor.w
instructions.pseudocode: t = M[rs1] ; M[rs1] = t ^ rs2 ; rd = t

instructions.name: amoand.w
instructions.pseudocode: t = M[rs1] ; M[rs1] = t & rs2 ; rd = t

instructions.name: amoor.w
instructions.pseudocode: t = M[rs1] ; M[rs1] = t | rs2 ; rd = t

instructions.name: amomin.w
instructions.pseudocode: t = M[rs1] ; M[rs1] = min( t, rs2 ) (signed) ; rd = t

instructions.name: amomax.w
instructions.pseudocode: t = M[rs1] ; M[rs1] = max( t, rs2 ) (signed) ; rd = t

instructions.name: amominu.w
instructions.pseudocode: t = M[rs1] ; M[rs1] = min( t, rs2 ) (unsigned) ; rd = t

instructions.name: amomaxu.w
instructions.pseudocode: t = M[rs1] ; M[rs1] = max( t, rs2 ) (unsigned) ; rd = t

sections.title: Program Counter
rows: Address of the current instruction; not an operand, read with auipc, changed by jumps and branches

sections.title: fcsr Fields
rows: Dynamic rounding mode, used when an instruction's rm is dyn (111)

sections.title: Rounding Modes (rm, frm)
rows: Round to nearest, ties to even
Round to nearest, ties to max magnitude
Dynamic: the rounding mode in frm (rm only)

sections.title: The Stack (ilp32d calling convention)
rows: The stack grows towards lower addresses; sp points to the last word in use
sp stays a multiple of 16 at every call
A function that calls others saves ra in its frame
Optional base of the frame, saved by the callee like every s register
Arguments that do not fit there are passed on the stack, at sp on entry
No red zone: memory below sp may be overwritten at any time
